La radio publique au cœur de la relation: Public radio at the heart of the relationship between institutions and citizens
Le Centre culturel Aïssa-Messaoudi a acc: The Aïssa-Messaoudi Cultural Center hosted a coordination meeting bringing together central directors as well as heads of national, thematic, and regional channels from all wilayas. Chaired by the Minister of Communication, Mohamed Bouslimani, the meeting took place in the presence of Kamal Sidi Saïd, Advisor to the President of the Republic in charge of the General Directorate of Communication at the Presidency of the Republic, and Hicham Allali, Director General of Algerian Radio.
Dans son allocution d'ouverture, le mini: In his opening speech, the Minister of Communication emphasized the central role of radio in the daily lives of citizens, highlighting its broad territorial coverage and proximity. He insisted on the imperative to maintain this bond to enable the population to access information and follow the actions carried out by the State.
Intervenant à son tour, Kamal Sidi Saïd: Speaking in turn, Kamal Sidi Saïd highlighted the commitment of the President of the Republic, Abdelmadjid Tebboune, to the institution. He praised the radio's contribution to spreading the national message and defending strategic interests, while insisting on the necessary support for regional stations.
De son côté, le directeur général Hicham: For his part, Director General Hicham Allali outlined the priorities for the organization's future, calling for increased performance and improved content. The targeted objective is to adapt the radio to the changes in the media sector while consolidating its role as a local public service.
